title: PBGC Pension Insurance Data Tables (single-employer and multiemployer programs)
questions: PBGC single-employer program net position over time
number of participants in PBGC-insured multiemployer plans
PBGC premium rates history (flat-rate and variable-rate)
special financial assistance paid to multiemployer plans
PBGC maximum guaranteed benefit by year

manual.how: Open https://www.pbgc.gov/about/reports/pension-insurance-data in a browser, click the Excel link in the row of the edition you need (e.g. "2024 Pension Insurance Data Tables (1st Installment)"), save the workbook under the name shown in INSTRUCTIONS.md, and upload it. The PDF next to it has the same tables with their titles.

cache.why: An edition changes only when PBGC posts a revision or the next installment; workbooks are 1-3 MB.

redistribution.why: PBGC is a federal agency; its data tables are U.S. government works (17 U.S.C. 105), in the public domain.

citation: Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation, Pension Insurance Data Tables ({dataset}), www.pbgc.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Single-employer program (S- tables), multiemployer program (M- tables), or both? They are separate insurance programs with separate finances, premiums and guarantees; never add them unless the table does (GLANCE has combined totals).

Which edition? The newest (2024, a 1st installment) lacks the Form 5500-based tables (participant status, funding, industry, state); those come from the 2023 edition. Default: the newest edition that has the table.
